messages.name: CreateCurrentTickAccount
messages.docs:
Create the current-tick actor of a price source, at tick `price_to_tick(initial_price)`.

Sent to the empty actor by the source: a program's actor (with the current-tick seed,
which admits the account), or a key at root, signing for its own account.

fields.name: initial_price
fields.docs: Opening spot price as `Q64.64` (`quote_asset` per `base_asset`).

messages.name: UpdateCurrentTick
messages.docs: From the source: set the tick to `price_to_tick(price)`, stamped with the clock.

fields.name: price
fields.docs: New spot price as `Q64.64`.

messages.name: CreatePriceAccounts
messages.docs:
From the source: create the observations and price actors of a window, both seeded
from the current tick.

fields.name: window_duration
fields.docs: The TWAP window in milliseconds; at least `OBSERVATIONS_CAPACITY`.

messages.name: RecordTick
messages.docs:
At root, to the current-tick actor: append the current tick to the window's ring
buffer, if a sampling interval has passed since the last entry.

messages.name: PublishPrice
messages.docs: At root, to the current-tick actor: publish the window's TWAP to its price actor.

fields.name: tick
fields.docs: The tick of the source's latest price, `price_to_tick(price)`.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.docs: Clock time of the latest `UpdateCurrentTick`; 0 until the first.

fields.name: pending
fields.docs: The operation waiting for the clock's reply; `None` between transactions.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.docs: Clock time (milliseconds) when this entry was recorded.

fields.name: tick_cumulative
fields.docs:
Running sum of `tick × elapsed_ms` up to this entry.

The TWAP over `[t1, t2]` is `(tick_cumulative[t2] - tick_cumulative[t1]) / (t2 - t1)`.

fields.name: base_asset
fields.docs: Canonical identifier for the priced asset.

fields.name: quote_asset
fields.docs: Canonical identifier for the quote asset that denominates `price`.

fields.name: price
fields.docs:
Amount of `quote_asset` one unit of `base_asset` is worth, as `Q64.64`
(`price / 2^PRICE_FRACTIONAL_BITS`). Zero is rejected on read.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.docs:
Price observation timestamp. Consumers choose the time unit by matching this with
`max_age`.

fields.name: source_id
fields.docs:
Identifier of the source that populated this price; for the TWAP, the price source's
account.

fields.name: confidence_interval
fields.docs: Source-provided confidence interval, or zero when the source does not provide one.

fields.name: price_source_id
fields.docs: The source's account: the pool or the key.

fields.name: current_tick
fields.docs: The current-tick actor's account: the only sender of `SampleTick` and `ComputePrice`.

fields.name: window_duration
fields.docs: The TWAP window in milliseconds; sets the sampling interval.

fields.name: write_index
fields.docs: Index of the *next* slot to write (wraps at `OBSERVATIONS_CAPACITY`).

fields.name: total_entries
fields.docs: Total entries ever appended (never resets; tells a partial buffer from a full one).

fields.name: last_recorded_tick
fields.docs:
The tick most recently *recorded*: the clamped value, not the source's raw tick.

Storing the clamped value makes [`MAX_TICK_DELTA`] a bound on the accumulator: the
recorded tick walks toward the true price at `MAX_TICK_DELTA` per observation.

fields.name: entries
fields.docs: Always exactly `OBSERVATIONS_CAPACITY` entries.

fields.name: tick
fields.docs: The clamped tick, as recorded.
